raw_gate: Every formal public raw guard minimum must remain strictly positive. The local normalization is an additional qualification margin and never replaces the raw sign gate.
design_principle: Normalize distance from the unchanged raw zero by the local geometric quantity that defines that failure mode. Cell-size quantities use their matching rest-material span; contact quantities use the required local center separation; native dimensionless angular or projective quantities retain scale one.

MINIMUM_SEGMENT_LENGTH.aggregation: minimum normalized margin over all unchanged segments
MINIMUM_SEGMENT_LENGTH.mesh_objectivity_reason: Both the physical segment length and its matching rest-material span shrink under material refinement while their local stretch ratio remains finite.

BENDING_TURN_CLEARANCE.aggregation: minimum native dimensionless margin over all unchanged internal vertices
BENDING_TURN_CLEARANCE.mesh_objectivity_reason: The guard is already an order-one local angular measure and contains no material-cell length factor.

AERODYNAMIC_CHORD_LENGTH.local_scale: sum of the two adjacent segment rest_material_length_m values
AERODYNAMIC_CHORD_LENGTH.aggregation: minimum normalized margin over all unchanged aerodynamic beads
AERODYNAMIC_CHORD_LENGTH.mesh_objectivity_reason: The two-neighbour chord and its corresponding two-segment rest span refine together.

BOB_ROD_CLEARANCE.raw_domain: the unchanged bob-to-rod segment domain, including the fixed lower bob-socket exclusion
BOB_ROD_CLEARANCE.local_scale: bob_contact_radius_m + half_branch_diameter_m + minimum_clearance_m for that branch
BOB_ROD_CLEARANCE.aggregation: minimum normalized margin over every unchanged checked segment
BOB_ROD_CLEARANCE.mesh_objectivity_reason: The required local center distance defines contact and is independent of segment subdivision.

ROD_SELF_CLEARANCE.raw_domain: the unchanged registered same-branch material-separation and cross-branch socket-complement domains
ROD_SELF_CLEARANCE.local_scale: branch_diameter_m + minimum_clearance_m for same-branch candidates; required_center_separation_m for cross-branch candidates
ROD_SELF_CLEARANCE.aggregation: minimum normalized margin over every unchanged registered category
ROD_SELF_CLEARANCE.mesh_objectivity_reason: The denominator is the local separation that defines the contact zero, not the apparatus characteristic length.

BOB_SOCKET_MATERIAL_EXTENT.raw_domain: the unchanged fixed lower rest-material bob socket
BOB_SOCKET_MATERIAL_EXTENT.mesh_objectivity_reason: Both quantities are fixed rest-material lengths and do not depend on how the socket is split across cells.

BOB_SOCKET_RADIAL_MONOTONICITY.aggregation: minimum local direction cosine over every unchanged socket cell, with every raw dot product still required positive
BOB_SOCKET_RADIAL_MONOTONICITY.mesh_objectivity_reason: The local direction cosine removes the material-cell span while retaining the exact radial-increase sign.

BOB_SOCKET_CUT_CLEARANCE.raw_domain: the unchanged fixed-material bob-socket cut point
BOB_SOCKET_CUT_CLEARANCE.mesh_objectivity_reason: The cut is a fixed affine rest-material point and the required local radius defines its zero.

JUNCTION_SOCKET_MATERIAL_EXTENT.raw_domain: both incident fixed rest-material sockets for every unchanged branch pair
JUNCTION_SOCKET_MATERIAL_EXTENT.aggregation: minimum normalized extent over both branches of every unchanged pair
JUNCTION_SOCKET_MATERIAL_EXTENT.mesh_objectivity_reason: The fixed rest-material total and socket lengths do not depend on cell subdivision.

JUNCTION_SOCKET_PROJECTIVE_OPENING.raw_domain: the unchanged Cartesian product of both fixed-material junction sockets
JUNCTION_SOCKET_PROJECTIVE_OPENING.aggregation: minimum native dimensionless projective margin over every unchanged branch pair
JUNCTION_SOCKET_PROJECTIVE_OPENING.mesh_objectivity_reason: The formal measure is already normalized by material distance squared and contains no unbalanced cell-span factor.

JUNCTION_SOCKET_CUT_CLEARANCE.raw_domain: the two unchanged fixed-material socket cuts for every branch pair
JUNCTION_SOCKET_CUT_CLEARANCE.aggregation: minimum normalized cut clearance over every unchanged branch pair
JUNCTION_SOCKET_CUT_CLEARANCE.mesh_objectivity_reason: The affine rest-material cuts are mesh independent and the pair's required local separation defines the contact zero.

prefreeze_requirements: implementation resolves exactly all 11 formal public guard components
resolved raw minima reproduce the formal public raw margins within a frozen roundoff tolerance
similarity tests preserve every length-based normalized margin
material refinement tests preserve the segment, aerodynamic-chord and radial-monotonicity normalization identities
raw zero and negative counterexamples fail closed
the exact numeric threshold 0.0003 and strict comparison are unchanged
dynamic_requirement: Any future trajectory qualification must apply the same local component definitions to accepted steps or to separately verified continuous lower bounds. A prepared-state result is not a trajectory certificate.
retroactivity: none; all historical v1 status, dynamic qualification, source-probe findings and space-Cauchy findings remain unchanged
promotion_requirement: Formal source or validation-spec modification requires explicit model-owner authorization and fresh full numerical qualification from frozen inputs.
claim_boundary: This is a complete candidate normalization contract, not a formal solver change and not evidence of numerical convergence, physical validity or experiment.
